scripts.dev: concurrently -n NextJS,Markdown -c green,blue --kill-others "npm run --silent dev-frontend" "cd md-compiler && npm --silent run dev"
scripts.build: cd md-compiler && npm --silent run build && cd .. && npm --silent run build-frontend
scripts.build-via-docker: rm -fr out && docker build -t www.ferrybig.nl:files --target export . -o out
scripts.start: docker build -t www.ferrybig.nl:server --target server . && docker --rm --name www.ferrybig.nl --publish 2999:2999 www.ferrybig.nl:server
scripts.clean: find app -name '*.js' -not -path '*/_components/*' -delete && find app -type d -empty -delete && rm -rf out app/.generated_files.txt app/content.d.ts && cd md-compiler && npm run clean
